en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street façade in Pécs, Hungary. The two‑story neoclassical building bears a large sign reading "BUDAIKÜLV. KATHKÖR." (Budai suburb Catholic Circle). People stand on the sidewalk; a small shop sign reads "RITS JÁNOS." Handwritten greeting appears across the image. The reverse says "LEVELEZŐ LAP" with a green 5 fillér Hungarian stamp and a Pécs postmark, plus a handwritten address within the city.
